title: Tax form submitted: staff are now told only through What's New
text: When a client submits their tax data, the Review tax data card is no longer created on the To-Do board and no email is sent to support. The note in What's New is now the only signal for staff, for both the portal form and the older emailed form.
points: Messages to the client asking for changes, and the notice when staff apply changes, are unchanged.
